videos.title: Gemma 4 Just Got Way More Powerful with Open WebUI
videos.description:
How to use Gemma 4. You installed Gemma 4 locally -- now it's time to give it a serious upgrade. In this video, I'll show you how to set up Open Web UI, a free tool that turns your local AI into a full ChatGPT-like experience with document uploads, knowledge bases, image analysis, and custom AI personas.
 
This is part two of the Gemma 4 series. In part one, we got Gemma 4 installed and running locally using Ollama. Now we're taking it further with Open Web UI, a free open-source interface that sits on top of Ollama and unlocks a ton of new features. I'll walk you through installing Docker, getting Open Web UI running with a single command, and then we'll explore the best features -- uploading documents and building permanent knowledge bases your AI can reference anytime, analyzing images, and creating custom personas for tasks like email writing. Everything still runs 100% on your machine, completely free and completely private.
 
Timestamps:
0:00 Intro
0:42 What is Open Web UI?
1:36 Installing Docker
2:32 Running the install command
3:21 Opening Open Web UI in your browser
4:06 Exploring the chat interface
4:52 Uploading documents to a conversation
5:17 The problem with one-off uploads
5:28 Building a Knowledge Base
6:40 Using a Knowledge Base in chat
6:58 Testing it fully offline
7:30 How knowledge bases work behind the scenes
8:12 Image analysis with Gemma 4
8:57 Creating custom AI personas
10:42 Trying larger Gemma 4 models
12:32 Recap and what's next
 
Docker Desktop: https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/

Open Web UI Install Command: 

docker run -d -p 3000:8080 --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v open-webui:/app/backend/data --name open-webui --restart always ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
